mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates compress the risk-free rate and reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: The rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is less than 0.05 in absolute value over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate level exceeding 4.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (the current condition) despite the signal being active.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1 percentage points and decrease in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 1000 persons within the last month signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases > 0.1pp and PAYEMS decreases > 1000 persons in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.1pp and PAYEMS decreases > 1000 persons in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 2000 units and RSAFS > 350000 million dollars), improved consumer confidence and spending drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as stronger industrial activity signals robust economic growth and higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The rank correlation between INDPRO and 5d returns is less than 0.05 in absolute value over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 2000 units within the last two months signals a housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 2000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.2% and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.1% within the last month signals a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.1% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% within the last month signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.
